description: Nigeria - Rural Electrification Modelling for five Nigerian Federal States is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Energy demand", published or maintained by Catherina Cader (Reiner Lemoine Institut). The data include results of the electrification modeling for the five Nigerian Federal States Cross River, Niger, Ogun, Plateau and Sokoto. Non-electrified village clusters were identified and a load was estimated. Coverage: Nigeria. It has 10 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access, Energy demand. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
